args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
Created: May 15, 2024
Trip Dates: June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Power bank
- Travel adapter (if needed)

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2-3 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals/flip-flops
- Water shoes (for snorkeling and rocky beaches)
- Hat/cap for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towel
- Beach bag
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion/aloe vera
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Waterproof phone case
- Dry bag for valuables

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking boots or sturdy shoes
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Quick-dry t-shirts
- Rain jacket (for unexpected showers)
- Daypack/backpack
- Water bottle/hydration system
- Insect repellent

HEALTH & PERSONAL CARE:
- Prescription medications
- Basic first aid kit
- Motion sickness medication
- Hand sanitizer
- Toiletries
- Shampoo/conditioner
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- Pearl Harbor visit: Respectful attire (covered shoulders/knees)
- Luau: Optional aloha shirt/dress
- Spa day: Nothing needed (provided by spa)
- Shopping day: Reusable shopping bags

ELECTRONICS:
- Laptop/tablet (optional)
- Headphones
- Waterproof camera (optional)
- Portable speaker (for beach)

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books/magazines for relaxation
- Travel pillow
- Snacks for day trips
- Reusable water bottle
- Small umbrella

Based on planned activities:
- June 11: Beach day at Waikiki Beach
- June 12: Snorkeling at Hanauma Bay
- June 13: Hiking at Diamond Head
- June 14: Visit to Pearl Harbor
- June 15: Road trip to the North Shore
- June 16: Luau experience at Polynesian Cultural Center
- June 17: Relaxation day at the hotel spa
- June 18: Kayaking at Kailua Beach
- June 19: Shopping at Ala Moana Center
- June 20: Departure
